_comment: Hierarchical MILP AllGather on rail_optimized_256gpu_dual_plane with switch copy. 256-GPU rail-optimized dual-plane fabric. Every GPU has a port into both planes, so every host transit is co-located (forward dwell 1). Hierarchical only. milp_chunking=4: one MILP chunk = 4 of a host's 8 identities for one destination-cell set, so 2 chunks per host -- between 'holder' (8, intractable here) and 'cell' (1, voids multipath across the 8 uplinks). Bundles span holder GPUs, so three GPUs of each group of four stage through the NVSwitch. switch_copy [true, false]: the network switches of the coarse level copy -- a fan-out is one Send, charged once on its uplink, and ncclize emits it as ONE multicast send threadblock (tb send="r1,r2") with one mscclflowid, plus a switch-JSON (format 2) entry listing every out port; the cell NVSwitches do not copy (multicast there needs NVLS). Pass --no-multicast to ncclize for the pre-multicast output (one unicast send per branch). SLOWEST_LINK keeps every coarse link at >= 1 chunk/epoch (occupancy 1: no multi-epoch legs). objective_type 6 (LEXICOGRAPHIC) puts makespan first; PAPER (3) ties on it. Outputs: Schedules/<prefix>_flat.json (+ _coarse/_identities/_intra side outputs). EXPERIMENT (branch milp-merged-latency-chain): tiers makespan > host_relay > latency + switch_chain at weight 1 (see AllGatherFormulation.hierarchical_objective_tiers); the merged tier gets the same pre-root NoRel budget as a cost tier but no floor stop. Compare against b4_nows_nodrop (latency -9152, switch_chain 133, merged -9019, flat finish 0.33944 = 611 flat epochs, 4588 s) and b4_nows_nolatency (latency -8923, switch_chain 66, merged -8857, flat 0.3400 = 612, 7222 s). Known scores at weight 1: constructed chain design -9028, leaf broadcast -8864, so expect the latency-saturating side unless an in-between schedule beats both. What to compare: flat 4-Collective_Finish_Time, the tier's latency and switch_chain parts (recompute from Schedules/<prefix>_coarse.json), solve time. No objective_tier_time_limit (the merged tier has no floor stop, so a limit would only shift time between its NoRel and its root); time_limit 2 h caps the run. num_epochs 8 IS the ingress bound (62 chunks into 8 in-links of 1 chunk/epoch), so no horizon past it can help; the leaf broadcast (2 columns per cell over 8 leaves) also takes 8, and the 2026-11-10 dual-plane b4_nows run (solved at 19) finished in exactly 8. symmetry false: no twin-switch flow-equality rows and no switch 'inflow == max(outs)' rule. Both restrict the model (neither is exact for a MILP), and the second costs a gp.max_ per copying-switch row. chunk_symmetry_breaking (default on) orders a host's interchangeable chunks instead, which is exact. See teccl/hierarchy/milp_design.md and teccl/ncclize/multicast_output_design.md.
